digest.component_or_area: close STATUS event and completion-signature attestation
propositions: A close event cannot be distinguished from gate-off when completion-signature append fails, because gate state and close provenance are not persisted durably on the close STATUS event

completion_expectation must record eight distinct values (required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) to separate all close paths and enable a later reader to discriminate signature-lost from gate-off without holding a lock
completion_expectation must be written in the same locked write as the close (txn.transition_core) to avoid a second lock acquisition whose timeout would mask the very failure being recorded
_completion_precheck must return a pair (verified_result, completion_expectation) and consume the tri-state GateState to distinguish gate-off from config-unreadable faults
An idea→closed transition must record completion_expectation=not_applicable since it bypasses _completion_precheck entirely and represents a REJECT/DROP, not a completion
Legacy close events lacking the completion_expectation field must reduce to state with the key absent (unknown/backward-compatible), never guessed
